[LFAC.1.7.6] **`ttl` / event facts carry no markers.** A
`mutable` payload presupposes supersedure, the defining
property of `logical`; `ttl` facts have no per-identity
uniqueness ([LFAC.1.3.2]) — they accumulate and expire — so
`key` / `mutable` are a category error on them. The compiler
rejects a marker on a non-`logical` slot. A `ttl` schema's
grouping needs (cooldown-per-entity, series `by:`) are separate
per-consumer concepts, unchanged by this model.
